ingest_disposition.reason: Direct exact-donor source forensics deepens the already-ingested Stop-hook finding. No duplicate packet consumption is minted.

source_atoms.finding: MicroClay.retrieve receives turn_id, episode_id, causal_id and generation, creates a fresh retrieval_id, and persists the full tuple in retrieval_episodes. _microclay_schatten creates fresh per-round turn_id, episode_id and causal_id rather than relying on the session-level active_turns identity.

MicroClay._apply_credit derives a deterministic receipt identity from retrieval_id, causal_id, generation, signal_class and credit, then persists retrieval_id, causal_id and generation in retrieval_feedback. Exact feedback identity therefore exists after a row is chosen.

_kognition_richten_hook is invoked with session_id plus transcript_path, reacquires the target retrieval via newest same-session row lacking modell:relevanz (ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1), and independently reconstructs the query by returning the last user text in the transcript. It does not receive the retrieval_id/turn_id/episode_id/causal_id/generation created for the originating UserPromptSubmit round.

Stop performs _kognition_richten_hook before _gw_absicht_schreiben, governance-turn accounting and waiting-status update. Event-wide _HookTimeout transfers control to the outer timeout handler and returns 0; interrupted Stop statements are not resumed. This is source-level control-flow evidence, not an installed-runtime latency result.

Current source preserves a historical LIVE bug note: reusing session-level turn_id/episode_id caused UNIQUE failures after the first message; the fail-silent path left one retrieval episode per session across the observed 106 sessions until per-round identities were introduced. This historical donor evidence directly argues against returning to session-only association for round-scoped feedback.

root_cause_refinement.finding: The donor already has enough round-scoped identity to represent an exact retrieval-to-feedback causal join. The weak point is the Stop/model-judge interface, which discards the originating tuple and later guesses the target from session-local recency plus independently reconstructed transcript text.
root_cause_refinement.important_consequence: A feedback receipt can be cryptographically/deterministically self-consistent for the wrong retrieval row: receipt hashing proves which selected row was credited, not that the selected row belonged to the Stop event's originating user round.

fusion_with_current_trigger4.refinement: For RetrievalRelevanceCandidate, migration is easier than a new identity schema: preserve and carry the donor's existing retrieval_id + turn_id + episode_id + causal_id + generation tuple through deferred cognition and typed re-entry; fail closed on tuple/generation mismatch. Do not use newest-open-row selection as the causal join.
fusion_with_current_trigger4.shared_envelope_status: STILL_CANDIDATE; this delta does not prove that one generalized DeferredCausalReturnEnvelope is superior to specialized bindings.

contradictions_preserved: Exact round identity exists in retrieval_episodes and retrieval_feedback, yet Stop-side model feedback currently chooses its target using session-local newest-row ordering.
The donor has already repaired one session-level round-identity failure in MicroClay, while a different session-level reassociation remains in the model relevance path.
The deterministic feedback receipt is strongly bound after row selection, but semantic attribution can still be wrong if row selection is wrong.
counterhypotheses: If Claude Code guarantees strict non-overlapping Stop processing and the latest transcript user text always corresponds to the latest uncredited retrieval, the current selector may behave correctly in ordinary operation; only an overlapping/reordered execution discriminator can promote that claim.
A smaller specialized retrieval binding may be preferable to the generalized DeferredCausalReturnEnvelope even though the shared causal-return shape is useful conceptually.

required_discriminators: Create two same-session retrieval episodes with distinct retrieval_id/turn_id/episode_id/causal_id/generation bindings and force reverse/interleaved Stop relevance completion; fail if modell:relevanz attaches to the wrong tuple.
Verify any successor carries the originating tuple directly rather than reconstructing it via ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1.
Run cognition-disabled, warm, slow/cold and unreachable local-model Stop conditions and prove deterministic tail bookkeeping completes under the successor design without modifying Frank's Harness.
Negative test stale generation/replayed candidate return: fail closed rather than credit a newer retrieval.

next_exact_gate: Triggerword-4 external/non-provider verification: execute the exact tuple-bound reverse-order retrieval test and Stop slow/unreachable-model tail-bookkeeping test against current successor design; promote no runtime claim until exact source/build/runtime receipts exist.
